purpose: Deterministically verify Doc Hub renders external document metadata exactly, matched semantically field-by-field rather than by substring.
preconditions: Sandbox build identity verified against the approved SHA.

Seed the workspace with exactly this file content: # GEORDI-QA external document metadata fixture

Deterministic body for semantic metadata matching.

steps.action: Open the seeded GEORDI-QA metadata fixture document in Doc Hub.
steps.expect: The document opens with its metadata panel/details visible.

steps.action: Read the displayed document metadata fields.
steps.expect: Title, source, MIME type, size, and modified time match the pinned values exactly (semantic field equality).

steps.action: Cross-check one metadata field against the Files API response for the same document.
steps.expect: The UI value and the API value agree exactly for the checked field.

cleanup: Delete the seeded GEORDI-QA metadata fixture document.
forbidden: Substring matching of displayed metadata against serialized metadata strings.
Entering credentials or approving permission prompts.
